title: Egyptian Date Cake
description: A moist and sweet cake made with heavy ingredients and a hint of honeyed flavor, inspired by traditional Egyptian desserts. Perfect for a special occasion or a sweet treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cake mix, honey, eggs, and butter. Mix until well combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
